ev.q: Estimated global DTP3 coverage in the 193 WHO member states increased from 74% in 2000 to 82% in 2009
National DTP3 coverage of ≥90% was reported by 122 (63%) countries
Three-dose coverage with HepB vaccine (HepB3) increased from 30% to 70% during this period
approximately 23 million children (half of whom live in India and Nigeria) did not receive 3 doses of DTP vaccine
Estimated global DTP3 coverage in the 193 WHO member states increased from 74% in 2000 to 82% in 2009
the overall increase mainly was attributed to improvements in vaccination coverage in the African (+16%)
but only 48 (25%) reported ≥80% coverage in all districts
This report summarizes global routine vaccination coverage during 2000--2009 and progress toward achieving GIVS goals.
From 2000 to 2009, estimated global MCV1 coverage increased from 71% to 82%
GIVS aims to achieve 90% national 3-dose DTP (DTP3) coverage by age 12 months in all countries

methods_quotes.q: Administrative vaccination coverage is calculated by dividing vaccine doses reported to have been administered to the target population by the total estimated target population.
A representative sample of households is selected, and vaccination coverage is determined by examining the child's immunization card or by parental recall.
WHO and UNICEF systematically review data from sources including government JRF reports
to derive annual estimates of national coverage with recommended vaccines
